summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Candor SaaS. Mocked entire external backend (https://api.candor-mock.test) using page.route with CORS headers. Covered landing page, theme toggle, context switcher (ADMIN/HR/VIEWER), RBAC nav + routes, interview list/detail/search/filter/error+retry, create interview payload shape, resume upload validation + success + multipart + no tenant header, invitations accept (no tenant), personal interview room start-session, pricing plans. All 52 assertions passed across two test runs (36 in run 1 after fixing 2 test-script issues, 16 in run 2).
critical_code_review_comments: No functional issues found. Code is well-structured: fieldMap.js centralizes payload shapes, client.js interceptor correctly conditionally attaches X-Tenant-ID only for /organization routes and respects skipTenant for /organization/invitation/accept.
RequirePermission + role gating via permissions.js correctly hides nav + enforces access-restricted on direct URL access for VIEWER.
React Query retries on 5xx cause ~6-8s delay before error state visible on list; consider lowering retry count or adding earlier loading indicator for better UX. Not a bug.
Pricing plan names in landing are individual/team/enterprise (correct).
test_credentials: None - dev session hardcoded via /app/frontend/src/config/devSession.js (token: dev-access-token-replace-me)
seed_data_creation: All data mocked inline via Playwright page.route. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App has NO backend; all API calls hit https://api.candor-mock.test which is unresolvable. Any Playwright test MUST mock via page.route with CORS headers (Allow-Origin:*, Allow-Headers:*, Expose-Headers:ETag) and respond 204 to OPTIONS. Verified contract: /organization/* calls include X-Tenant-ID = active orgId, /user/* calls do NOT, /organization/invitation/accept does NOT (uses skipTenant). Every call includes Authorization: Bearer dev-access-token-replace-me. Create-interview payload for org has exactly {title,description,skills,candidateEmail,companyName,role}; personal omits candidateEmail. React Query retries 5xx twice (~6-8s) before showing error state - wait >=7s for error retry button to appear. Resume file input is hidden (set_input_files works directly without wait_for_selector visible). Pricing plans ids: individual/team/enterprise (not 'starter'). Video multipart upload (uploadVideoMultipart) was NOT exercised through full E2E but code is in /app/frontend/src/lib/videoUpload.js and uses /interview/upload/start, /interview/video/sign-url, PUT to signed URLs expecting ETag header, /interview/upload/complete with parts [{PartNumber,ETag}].
tested_flows: Landing: hero, product preview, usecase tabs (org/individual), FAQ accordion, footer, theme toggle (dark<->light persisted), pricing plans
Context switcher lists Individual + 3 orgs; switching updates URL, sidebar nav, topbar-context-name
ADMIN (Acme) nav: Overview, Interviews, New interview, Workspaces, Team
HR (Startup XYZ) nav: no team, workspaces visible but no open-create-workspace-button
VIEWER (Company ABC) nav: Overview, Interviews only; direct URL /interviews/new and /team show access-restricted; detail shows read-only-indicator and no open-interview-room-button
Interviews list: GET /organization/interviews returns array, auto-selects first on desktop (?i=slug), detail GET /organization/interview/:slug fires on select, search filters, status filter works
Error state: 500 on list shows retry button; retry recovers

Create interview (ADMIN): empty submit shows 6 validation errors; filled form POSTs /organization/interview with EXACT fields {title,description,skills,candidateEmail,companyName,role}; interview-created-card shown

Resume (/app/personal/resume): rejects .txt and >5MB with resume-validation-error; valid PDF uploads multipart/form-data to /user/resume/upload with Bearer token and NO X-Tenant-ID; resume-upload-success shown
Interview room (/app/personal/interviews/iv-1/room): realtime-boundary visible; start-session-button POSTs /user/interview/session with no tenant header
Invitations: POST /organization/invitation/accept has Bearer but NO X-Tenant-ID
